text: If all outlanders fight this good, we are in trouble.
Have at ye!
Who watches the Watchers?  Hahahaha...urk!
charges to make an attack.
I see clearly now.
You must be as stupid as you look.
It is going to be one of those days.  *SIGH*
Like hot butter through a knife.  Um, like a, well, you know what I mean. I am going to cut you!
prepares to crush you
I shall have my revenge one day.
I will flow as the water and emerge victorious.
spits black blood on your armor and slithers toward you.
spits black blood on your armor and slithers toward you.
continues to chant as it turns to face you!
scuttles forward to attack.
Greetings, my friend. What brings you so far from the trodden path? I hope you do not plan on stealing my [fishing spot].
sufferers numerous puncture woulds and falls dead to the ground.
lunges at you, causing small tremors with each step
Justice is swift and sure, foolish mortal.
curls into a ball as its tail shrivels.
attacks from nothing more than pure instinct.
spits venom at you as it notices you approach.
You hear a clicking sound as an Arachnae lunges toward you.
You kill, but there always be Bubonians!
You jump as pincers fly by your face.
begins to scream as its body falls limp.
roars and charges with its head lowered!
quickly moves to bind your limbs!
materializes out of the darkness
struggles towards its enemy, but falls short, letting out no more than a grunt, before it dies.
You have not chosen your battle wisely. Take up your swords, prepare your magicians, you will die this day!
soars into the air, preparing for an aerial attack, focusing its attention on you.
slumps to the ground unable to breathe.
erupts into life.
You dare strike an officer?!?
Death will come to you one day. That day will be a day without honor.
My life is extinguished, but my life force will live on to aid the shrine!
scurries quickly towards you.
slithers towards you, the look of poison evident on its fangs.
The power of storms is not yours to be had!
Brother, I have been slain. . . you must . . . avenge me!
Zek will rule the waves!
engulfs you!
Little whelp below me, prepare to meet the desert sand!
Your victory is meaningless.
The massive wurm corpse falls to the ground with a great thud, no remaining air left in its lungs.
Now you will understand the fury water can bring!
looks surprised as it falls dead.
Storm clouds begin to gather over your head.
You shall have all the Crushbone orc legions on your tail for my death!
makes an attempt to spear you with its nose.
swims quickly towards you intent on making you its next meal.
speeds towards its new victim.
Even now Coirnav awaits to deal swift death to you. Flee weaklings.
Ribbbbitt!
explodes into a pool of blood.
pursues you with unbelievable speed.
falls in a limp heap, whimpering as its life fades.
chortles as it chokes on its own blood.
The insect's carcass starts seeping a noxious ooze.
slices through the water in your direction.
The essence of the spirit floats into the turbulent air.
May your death be a warning to our enemies.
claws adoringly at its gaping wounds as it dies.
cracks the ground with the force of its fall.
The essence of the spirit floats into the turbulent air.
Dark blood spews from its mouth as the battle hardened mastruq takes a final swipe.
shudders and falls among her slaughtered children.
stammers as it falls to the ground.
dies and thuds to the ground.
detects your movement causing its skin to ripple.
Death to all who oppose Innoruuk's will!!
creeps forward twitching its deadly, jagged claws.
For the glory of the Deathfist Magistrate, your blood shall run!!
slams to the ground in a heap of matted fur.
Feel the ultimate wrath of the legion!
collapses to the ground as nothing more than rubble.
Come at me with all you have!
raises its body up and rushes forward at silently with venom dripping from its fangs.
defiantly falls to the ground, once again lifeless.
Orc stomp, orc kill - orc weapons, your blood will spill.
Can you even fathom the infinite torture and suffering in store for you? I thought not.
I hope you have lived your life with no regrets, for now it shall come to an end!
Welcome to your final stand, mortals. You shall progress no farther!
returns to the elements from which it was formed.
mutters a curse in an unknown language as he falls.
shrieks with demented laughter as it sets upon you.
Oh ho!  The insects try to sting me!  I shall dine well this day!
snarls with determined fury, then rushes directly at you!
Let this pathetic fool's death be an example of Trushar's will and power.  May the waves of the sea crush your life and wash the world clean of your existence.
lets out a hollow laugh. 'You will now feel the wind's cold warning, intruder!'
sinks to the ground, its scales dripping with rivulets of blood.
snorts loudly as it charges into battle.
You're not welcome in Freeport
writhes and screams as it dies.
dies gurgling as air slowly escapes from the depths of its gullet.
disappears in a peal of thunder, leaving only its armor.
rushes toward you in a maniacal rage!
Let your death be a warning to all who dare oppose the Freeport Militia!
spills its blood across the ground
Prepare to bleed!!
drops to its knees and falls forward to the ground.
You dishonor the mother!
's corpse yelps in pain and collapses.
churns the earth with its hooves and rushes forward.
's corpse squeals as it spins into the earth.
ai...yiyiyiyiyi....erp!
's corpse shudders spasmodically in death.
opens its palm in sudden surprise.
begins whispering a sinister, arcane language.
staggers and collapses into a pile of scrap metal.
growls and attack you.
calls for help as it swings at your head
waves its arms and gibbers incomprehensibly.
Uninvited guests to our master's home be shown the way out!
collapses into a heap of grimy dirt.
The end is near!! Prepare to die!!
dissipates as it hits the ground.
falls in a heap and continues dripping poison from its fangs.
slows its spinning until it eventually disappears entirely.
You shall die this day, foolish whelp, but it is not unto me that you will give you live, but to firiona Vie's failure you shall perish!
A single battle you have won, but so quick to think that this will be the end?  I, like Fear, am eternal, and in your dreams, I shall forever haunt.
Come, sisters!! A fool to test our blades upon!!
You shall have all the Crushbone orc legions on your tail for my death!
My comrades will avenge my death.
With my last breath, I call upon the vengeance of House Mistmoore!  Stalk the filth that strikes against our house and leave their organs strewn about the Lesser Faydark!
Smash you. . . No one bash better than Mudtoe.
Hardly a worthy adversary.  A member of the Indigo Brotherhood deserves a much better opponent.
Blast!! Another one to be tested!! My work is never done.
You will regret your actions.
glares at you, its thoughts entering your mind. 'Your intrusion will be met with force.'
clicks and buzzes. 'Ungawa!  Oogala! Dogo dogo!'
Undogo, oldogo, gaba, daga!
You have earned the vengeance of Faydark's Champions.
charges at you with its razor sharp horn lowered.
You have raided the tomb, and for that you will pay, today is the day you will play in the fray.
drops to the ground dead.
edges forward as it gets ready to attack.
collapses to the ground in a lifeless heap.
You have not won.  Consider yourself wanted by the Legion of Cabilis.
Prepare to greet your ancestors filth!
gets an angry look in its eyes and a small puff of spores shoots down from its cap with a hiss.
drops to the ground, life gone in the blink of an eye.
slumps in defeat, its unholy lifeforce departing.
slashes at you one last time as its life ends.
This is not good.
Your death shall be quick and clean.
You had best start praying Rhugol does not take offense to this!
Pain. Lots of pain!
I guess you won't be buying me that drink after all?
My brothers would die if they could see me now.  Ha!
looks very surprised.
Redhands is not my name, you know.  It is merely an occupational description.
Raaaaaaaar!
To arms!  To arms!
